title: acilepis pulneyensis
intro:

This shrub-like plant is known for its aromatic leaves and stems, which are used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Acilepis pulneyensis include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antibacterial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and prevent infections.
